title: Restart level from pause menu leaves game paused
observed: After pausing and clicking Restart level, the state stays in mode paused with the pause menu still open, instead of resuming play.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away.

title: Spikes with score below 500 wrap score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
observed: Stepping onto spikes with score 0-499 makes the score wrap to 65136 (negative value wrapped to unsigned 16-bit style).
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative.
